name: Coral dying without water
deviations: coral blocks and plants (not fans) are inert
currents that push entities do not see waterlogged fans' water
note: Coral fans and wall fans of every kind die 60 to 99 ticks (a level-random draw) after they are left without water, when placed or updated; they need a sturdy top or face and leave their water when they break; pistons break living fans and move dead ones
